proposal.rationale: Current profile tls13-x25519 is classical and below the policy's hybrid-pqc security floor, so migration is required. The asset has liboqs-0.16.0 implementing both PQC-capable allowlisted profiles. Checking readiness and capability advertisement: tls13-hybrid-x25519-mlkem768 (requires kem:x25519mlkem768) has 5 ready endpoints (peer-01 through peer-05); tls13-mlkem768 (requires kem:mlkem768) has only 1 (peer-01). Per the objective (maximize ready endpoints, then prefer higher security class among ties), the hybrid profile wins outright on endpoint count even though its security class (hybrid-pqc) is lower than pqc-class tls13-mlkem768 \u2014 there is no tie to break in favor of the higher class here. peer-06 only supports classical kem:x25519 and is excluded from this batch (not an unresolved dependency, since its readiness is confirmed 'known' \u2014 it simply lacks the required capability for any PQC-capable profile). Note: Engineering note SA-212 recommends 'tls13-x25519-fastpath', but that profile is not present on the public allowlist and appears to be a classical-only profile that would violate the hybrid-pqc security floor; per task scope I can only propose profiles copied exactly from the allowlist, so this alternative was not adopted and is flagged for the approver's awareness/reconciliation with SA-212.
